question: Rainfall is measured by an instrument called the ________.
solution:
the correct answer is __**rain gauge.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rain Gauge:-**

 
 
• The instrument used to measure rainfall is called a** rain gauge.**
 
• It is a simple tool that consists of a **cylindrical container **with a funnel on the top and a measuring scale on the side.
 
• The rain gauge **collects rainwater,** and the amount of water collected is measured using the scale.
 
• Rain gauges are commonly used by** meteorologists, hydrologists, and farmers** to monitor rainfall and plan for irrigation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rain Catcher:-**

 
 
• It is a device that **collects rainwater for later use.**
 
• Rainwater harvesting is a sustainable way to conserve water and reduce your reliance on municipal water supplies. 
 
 
 
• **Rain Calculator:-**
 
 
• It is a tool that can be **used to calculate the amount of rainfall that is expected to fall in a given area.**
 
• This can be useful for a variety of purposes, such as planning irrigation schedules, preventing flooding, and estimating the amount of water that can be collected for rainwater harvesting.
 
 
 
• **Precipitator:-**
 
 
• It is a device that **removes particulate matter from a gas stream.**
 
• It is used in a variety of industries, including power generation, cement production, and metal processing.
